newsitem.title: USA: Owosso sees Q4 loss, break-even yr results.
newsitem.headline: Owosso sees Q4 loss, break-even yr results.

text.p: Owosso Corp said on Wednesday that it expects to report a loss in the fourth quarter and to be at or near break-even for the fiscal year.

The company said the results were hurt by certain charges, including year-end inventory valuation adjustments and the results of its inventory reduction at its heat transfer coil business. A higher tax rate and other adjustments also will affect the quarterly and year-end results, Owosso said.
